chunks: And Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Mabindath and Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himari narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Hilal narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Mahboob al-Zarrad narrated to us, saying: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) said to me:

Indeed, O Hasan, there will be a deaf and dumb sedition in which every close friend and companion will perish. (And in another narration: every close friend and companion will fall). That will be when the Shia lose the third from my offspring, for whose loss the people of the earth and the heavens will grieve. How many believing men and believing women will be regretful, eager, bewildered, and sorrowful for his loss. Then he bowed his head, then raised it and said: By my father and mother, he is the namesake of my grandfather and resembles me and resembles Moses son of Imran. Upon him are pockets of light blazing from the ray of the light of holiness, as if I see him when they despaired of him. He will be called with a call heard by those far away as well as those near. He will be a mercy to the believers and a torment to the disbelievers.

So I said: By my father and mother, it is you, and what is that call? He said: Three voices in the month of Rajab; the first is: 'Surely the curse of Allah is on the unjust.' The second is: 'The near Event has drawn near, O company of believers!' And the third is that they will see a protruding hand with the disk of the sun calling: 'Surely Allah has sent so-and-so to destroy the unjust.' At that time, deliverance will come to the believers, and Allah will heal their chests and remove the rage from their hearts.
ai.seo_question: What are the three signs in Rajab preceding the emergence of the Imam according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) identifies the 'deafening trial' with the occultation of the third descendant, linking it to the profound grief of the Shi'a for the loss of their Imam. He characterizes the Mahdi as the 'Simil' of his grandfather and Moses, emphasizing his divine radiance and role as mercy for believers. The narration culminates in the eschatological significance of three specific calls in Rajab, which announce his emergence and bring spiritual relief to the faithful.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (28) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Ahmad bin Mabindath and Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himari from Ahmad bin Hilal that al-Hasan bin Mahboob al-Zarrad had said: Imam ar-Redha (as) said: “O Hasan, There will be a dark sedition, in which close friends and near relatives will perish. That will occur when the Shia miss the fourth descendant of mine. The people of the earth and the inhabitants of the Heaven will be sad for missing him. Many faithful men and faithful women will be regretful, confused and sorrowful because of missing him.” He pondered for a while and then he raised his head and said: “He is the namesake of my grandfather (Prophet Muhammad). He looks like me and looks like Prophet Moses (as). Upon him there are rays of light emitting from the light of the Divine holiness. As if I see that people despair of him so much but they will be called with a call heard by the all whether far or near they are. He will be as mercy upon the believers and as torment upon the unbelievers.”
I said: “May my father and mother die for you! What will that call be?”

He said: “There will be three sayings in the month of Rajab; the first is “Now surely the curse of Allah is on the unjust,” the second is “The threatened Hour is nigh, O believers!” and the third is that people will see a protruding hand with the disk of the sun calling: “Allah has sent so-and-so to destroy the unjust”. Then deliverance comes to the believers and Allah relieves their hearts and takes distresses away from them.”
